title: Los Angeles weather: Rain moves through Southern California, creeps into Halloween forecast. Here's what to expect this weekend - ABC7 Los Angeles
text:
Los Angeles weather: Rain moves through Southern California, creeps into Halloween forecast. Here's what to expect this weekend - ABC7 Los Angeles 
 24/7 Live Los Angeles Orange County Inland Empire Ventura County California Weather 
 Rain moves through SoCal, creeps into Halloween forecast. Here's what to expect 
 Rain has moved into parts of Southern California as the region prepared for its first potentially wet Halloween since 2014. KABC Saturday, October 31, 2026 2:58AM Share Este artículo se ofrece en Español LOS ANGELES (KABC) -- Southern California is expected to see a wet Halloween weekend for the first time since 2014 as rain arrives into the region, while coastal communities continued monitoring elevated tides and minor flooding concerns.
 ABC7 has issued a Weather Change Alert due to the wet forecast.
 According to the National Weather Service, the main storm is expected to move eastward toward Southern California by Saturday afternoon and evening before pushing inland on Sunday.
 Current projections show rain arriving Saturday afternoon, potentially disrupting trick-or-treating and making it the first wet Halloween in Los Angeles since 2014.
 Rain is expected to continue through most of Sunday before conditions begin to clear Monday.
 Saturday forecast
 Los Angeles and Orange counties are expected to see an 80% chance of rain Saturday, with a high of 68 degrees and a low of 60. Up to three-quarters of an inch of rain could fall from late Saturday afternoon into Sunday morning.
 The valleys and Inland Empire Saturday will see a high of 70 degrees and a low of 54, with an 80% chance for showers. Rainfall totals expected to range from one-half inch to 1 inch.
 Beaches can expect an 80% chance of rain, with a high of 71 degrees and a low of 60 on Saturday. Surf is expected to be between 2 and 5 feet. Most rainfall is expected Saturday evening through Sunday morning, with up to one-half inch possible.
 Mountain communities will see a high of 52 degrees and a chilly overnight low of 34 on Saturday. An 80% chance of rain is in the forecast.
 Desert areas Saturday can expect a high of 66 degrees and a low of 46 on Saturday. Palm Springs is expected to reach a high of 78 degrees. There's a 70% chance for rain on Saturday.
